title: Item:Astral Shard
wikitext:
[[File:Astral Shard icon.png|50px|frameless|left|Astral Shard]]
'''Astral Shards''' are a form of [[currency]] introduced with [[Update 16 Patch 1]]. These can be used instead of platinum for many in-game services, such as minor [[respec]]s, item repairs and others.

Unlike platinum, Astral Shards are [[account]] wide, i.e., your shards are available for all your characters on the [[server]]. Unlike platinum, Astral Shards cannot be directly traded with another player (except via [[Shard Exchange]]).

Your Astral Shards balance is displayed in the bottom right corner of the screen.

== Sources ==
* Won from [[Daily Dice]]
* Earned by selling items on the [[Shard Exchange]]
* Earned by killing monsters from the [[Monster Manual]] (Volumes III and IV)
* {{Verify | Found rarely in chests (mentioned on 23 June 2013)}}
* Purchased with [[DDO Point]]s from the [[DDO Store]]
